title_en: NFPA-based visual self-inspection ruleset (secondary, clause numbers unverified)
title_ko: NFPA 기반 외관 자체점검 규칙셋 (보조 — 조문 번호 미확인)
scope_note: Kept as a second rule vocabulary so the same footage can be reported against US practice. We could not read the NFPA documents themselves (nfpa.org requires a login for the code text), so no clause numbers are asserted: every item is source_status=unverified and cites only the standard and the requirement in plain words. Items are the subset of kr-fire.json that has a direct NFPA counterpart.

sources.name: NFPA 10, Standard for Portable Fire Extinguishers (current edition not verified)
sources.method: Clause text is behind a login on nfpa.org — no clause numbers asserted (2026-10-28)

sources.name: NFPA 101, Life Safety Code (current edition not verified)
sources.method: Clause text is behind a login on nfpa.org — no clause numbers asserted (2026-10-28)

sources.name: NFPA 25, Standard for the Inspection, Testing, and Maintenance of Water-Based Fire Protection Systems (current edition not verified)
sources.method: Clause text is behind a login on nfpa.org — no clause numbers asserted (2026-10-28)

checks: Portable extinguishers are provided in the occupancy and are visible on the walked route.
If none is seen in this footage, the status is possibly_missing, not 'absent'.
checks_ko: 해당 용도에 맞는 소화기가 설치되어 보행 구간에서 보여야 한다.
이 영상에 안 보이면 possibly_missing — '없다'고 단정하지 않는다.
items.source: NFPA 10 — extinguishers shall be provided in accordance with the hazard of the occupancy (clause not verified)

checks: Extinguishers are conspicuously located where they will be readily accessible.
Nothing is stored or parked in front of the extinguisher or its cabinet.
checks_ko: 소화기는 눈에 잘 띄고 쉽게 접근할 수 있는 곳에 있어야 한다.
소화기(또는 수납함) 앞에 물건을 쌓거나 세워 두지 않는다.
items.source: NFPA 10 — extinguishers shall be conspicuously located and not obstructed (clause not verified)

items.name_en: Extinguisher not tipped over or damaged
checks: Extinguisher is in its designated place, not tipped over or fallen.
No visible dents, corrosion, cracked hose or missing nozzle.
checks_ko: 소화기는 지정된 자리에 바로 서 있어야 한다(넘어짐·이탈 없음).
찌그러짐·부식·호스 갈라짐·노즐 없음이 없어야 한다.
items.source: NFPA 10 — monthly visual inspection: extinguisher in designated place, no obvious damage (clause not verified)

checks: Gauge reading within the operable range.
Tag / inspection record present and current.
checks_ko: 지시압력계가 정상 작동 범위에 있어야 한다.
점검표시(태그)가 붙어 있고 최신이어야 한다.
items.source: NFPA 10 — inspection, maintenance and recharging intervals (clause not verified)

checks: Cabinet door opens fully and nothing is stored against its face.
checks_ko: 함 문이 완전히 열려야 하고 함 앞에 물건이 없어야 한다.
items.source: NFPA 25 — fire hose valves and cabinets shall be accessible and unobstructed (clause not verified)

items.name_en: Exit sign marks the way out
checks: Each required exit is marked with an approved exit sign visible from the escape route.
If none is seen in this footage, possibly_missing.
checks_ko: 피난경로에서 보이는 출구 표지가 있어야 한다.
이 영상에 안 보이면 possibly_missing.
items.source: NFPA 101 — marking of means of egress; exits shall be marked by an approved sign (clause not verified)

checks: No decorations, stock or fixtures obscure the sign.
The sign stays legible from the path it serves.
checks_ko: 장식물·적재물·설비가 표지를 가리지 않아야 한다.
표지는 그 경로에서 읽을 수 있어야 한다.
items.source: NFPA 101 — exit signs shall be visible and not obscured (clause not verified)

checks: Illumination is continuous and tested on the required schedule.
Video cannot prove correct illumination — needs_human_check.
checks_ko: 출구 표지는 상시 점등되어야 하고 정해진 주기로 시험해야 한다.
영상으로 점등을 확정할 수 없다 → needs_human_check.
items.source: NFPA 101 — exit signs shall be illuminated; testing and maintenance per NFPA 101A (clause not verified)

checks: Fire doors are kept closed and self-closing; hardware is intact.
An ordinary or glass shop door is not a fire door.
checks_ko: 방화문은 닫힘 상태를 유지하고 자동으로 닫혀야 하며 하드웨어가 온전해야 한다.
일반문·유리 상점문은 방화문이 아니다.
items.source: NFPA 101 — fire door assemblies: self-closing, kept in the closed position (clause not verified)

checks: Doors are not blocked, wedged or held open by any means other than an approved release device.
checks_ko: 승인된 해제장치 외의 방법으로 방화문을 고정 개방하면 안 된다.
items.source: NFPA 101 — fire doors shall not be blocked or held open except by approved hold-open devices (clause not verified)

checks: No holes, broken glazing, missing leaf or deformed frame.
checks_ko: 구멍·유리 파손·문짝 없음·틀 변형이 없어야 한다.
items.source: NFPA 101 — fire door assemblies shall be maintained in good repair (clause not verified)

checks: Detectors are not painted, capped or obstructed by stock or construction.
A round perforated ceiling grille is an air diffuser, not a detector.
checks_ko: 감지기에 도장·덮개·적재물에 의한 가림이 없어야 한다.
천장의 원형 격자는 공조 디퓨저이지 감지기가 아니다.
items.source: NFPA 72 — detectors shall not be obstructed or painted (clause not verified)

checks: Clear space below and around each head; nothing hung from or stacked under it.
Heads are not painted, deformed or missing.
checks_ko: 헤드 아래·주변 공간을 비워야 하고, 헤드에 매달거나 아래에 쌓지 않는다.
헤드 도장·변형·없음이 없어야 한다.
items.source: NFPA 25 — sprinklers shall be free of obstruction and in good condition; required clearance below deflectors (clause not verified)

checks: Means of egress are free of stored items, wheelchairs, carts and other obstructions.
The required width stays usable.
checks_ko: 피난통로에 적재물·휠체어·카트 등 장애물이 없어야 한다.
필요 폭이 확보되어야 한다.
items.source: NFPA 101 — means of egress shall be continuously maintained free of all obstructions (clause not verified)
